# Guide-informed pure builds and training experiments

Research date: 14 September 2026
Repository reviewed: `StingingT/clawscape-agents`
Implementation baseline: PR #7, commit `a050f7634f1cfcf7cfe297fc7aefd3f8527df658`
Original status: researched replacement specification, not code.

Implementation addendum: this specification is preserved as the requested research basis. See `BUILD_GUIDES.md` for the implemented subset, verification, remaining compatibility gates and deployment limits. The source list and original research limitations below are unchanged.

## 1. Purpose and authority

Replace two loosely defined pure strategies with a sourced library of build options and training leads. The agent chooses its strategy, proposes preparation and experiments, and revises its choices from its own evidence. This document is not a predetermined levelling script.

Keep the hierarchy:

`development strategy -> strategic goal -> support goals -> plan -> methods -> actions -> verified results and review`

Sources serve different purposes:

- Online guides describe possible strategies, unlocks and training locations. They do not establish this server's mechanics.
- Matching server definitions establish which content and rules exist in the inspected server version. They do not prove personal access, survivability or the agent's ability to execute a method.
- The character's own current observations establish state, equipment, access, prices and supported actions.
- Attributed activity results establish how a method actually performed for that character.

PvP remains disabled. A build's reputation in PvP is a reason to study it, not permission to initiate player combat or proof of PvP competence from PvM results.

## 2. Important findings from the current implementation

`src/agency/development.ts` currently offers `ranged-magic-pure` and `strength-prayer-pure`. The latter freezes Attack at its currently observed XP, focuses on Strength/Prayer, and also protects Ranged/Magic. Adoption accepts base Defence up to 5. Its default review exits a pure after three attributed costly combat trials if Defence training is available. These are implementation heuristics, not specific guide-backed builds. [R1]

`src/training/catalog.ts` already treats guide recommendations as leads and resolves NPC definitions and spawns from local content. Preserve that separation. It currently reads `_unpack/225/all.npc` but constructs a `local-274-...` namespace. Neither label alone establishes the actual server revision. It already excludes Stronghold routes and defers giants requiring unverified transitions. [R2]

The supplied server repository `Joostrothweiler/clawscape` returned 404 through the active connection during this review. Its content, custom mechanics and exact revision were not independently inspected. Do not replace it with assumptions about a different publicly hosted server.

## 3. Initial build library

The following are candidate families. A selected level milestone is a deliberate review point; it is not permission to cross other caps. Maximum-level completion is not required before gathering useful evidence.

| Profile | Guide-supported starting concept | Adaptation proposed for these agents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ranged/Magic one-Defence hybrid | Develop Ranged and Magic while retaining 1 Defence; balancing the offensive skills is a common modern guide principle. [S1] | Compare available ranged and spell methods. Keep Attack/Strength unchanged initially only if that is part of the selected variant. Begin with a separately chosen Prayer policy; do not import later ranged/magic prayers. |
| Rune-weapon melee pure | 40 Attack unlocks rune weapons; Strength is the main growth skill. Guides commonly consider 1, 13 or 31 Prayer. [S2] | A better general melee candidate than indefinitely locking Attack at 1. Advance Attack through observed equipment unlocks toward 40 only after adoption. Compare Prayer benefits against combat-level and resupply costs. |
| Ranged/melee hybrid | 40 Attack, high Strength/Ranged and 1 Defence underpin the bow-plus-rune-melee approach. [S3] | Permit the necessary melee preparation under the same strategy. Weapon-switching competence must be implemented and measured; knowing the build does not create it. |
| Dragon-weapon one-Defence hybrid | 60 Attack is a common dragon-weapon threshold. Lost City is associated with dragon dagger/longsword access. [S4, S5] | A conditional later option only when relevant items, requirements, quest access and supported execution are established. Do not assume a dragon scimitar or special attacks merely from the label '2004'. |

An open-development strategy must remain available. Agents whose existing XP is incompatible with a one-Defence profile must not be called one-Defence pures or have their history reset. A low-Defence experimental build can be a separately named strategy.

### Prayer is a separate decision

Do not equate 'Strength/Prayer pure' with unlimited Prayer training. The melee guide's 1/13/31 alternatives motivate explicit choice points, not an instruction to bury every bone. [S2]

43 Prayer is a possible PvM support milestone because it unlocks Protect from Melee in the referenced game. The server's implementation, available enemies, drain/restoration and action support still need validation. [S6]

At a Prayer cap, a Bury action or quest reward is an XP-bearing action that needs the same boundary checks as an attack. Do not use irreversible XP gain as the first way to discover whether an action violates the current build.

### Avoid unsuitable defaults

Modern low-Attack warhammer builds rely on equipment assumptions that cannot be imported unchanged: warhammer wielding requirements changed from Attack to Strength in April 2021. [S7]

Granite-maul, obsidian, Void and godsword variants should remain compatibility-gated research options rather than executable targets on a nominally 2004 server. For example, the granite maul is post-2004 content. [S4, S8]

Do not import Eagle Eye, Mystic Might or similar ranged/magic prayer boosts into a 2004 model: the cited Jagex announcement introduced those families in August 2006. [S9]

Rock crabs were introduced on 2 November 2004; experiments on 31 January 2005. Even familiar 'old-school' training advice can therefore be too late for an early-2004 revision. [S10, S11]

The Lost City preservation roadmap distinguishes multiple 2004 revisions and places special attacks after its May revision. This is context for compatibility checking, not proof that the user's fork matches that roadmap. [S12]

## 4. Training leads to seed

No entry supplies executable coordinates, assumed XP/hour, guaranteed drops or a universal safe-level threshold.

| Lead | Why it is worth investigating | Gate before a productive trial |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lumbridge chickens, cows and goblins | Starter combat and possible useful materials; these families already appear in the local catalogue. [S13, R2] | Own NPC observation, permitted style, realistic food/ammunition budget and a verified way back. |
| Edgeville Monastery monks | An older melee guide describes a low-level training option with healing access. [S14] | Discover actual access, combat options and healing behaviour. A modern/archived description is not proof of zero damage or working healing. |
| Barbarian Village barbarians | An existing executable family in this repository rather than a compulsory progression tier. [R2] | Compare full-trip performance with the starter method. Do not select simply because the combat level is higher. |
| Hill giants, Edgeville Dungeon | Guides describe a ranged training option using safespots and useful bone drops. [S13] | Verify entry/exit transitions, required access items, NPC family, usable safespot and ammunition recovery. No modern boss-key assumption. |
| Moss giants, Varrock Sewers | A later ranged/magic training lead in the guide material. [S13] | Verify sewers access, obstacles, return route and the specific safe firing position. Treat resource and damage costs as unknown until measured. |
| Rock crabs north of Rellekka | Guide-described low-defence, higher-HP training option. [S10] | Confirm the appropriate content revision, route, dormancy/aggression mechanics and method support. Do not default to a later Waterbirth or modern Kourend location. |

Existing guards/Black Knights are comparison candidates, not automatically preferred pure-training methods. The existing giant-spider approach must not be adopted from a training guide without a separate Wilderness/route-risk check. [R2]

Only personally reachable, supported leads become executable trials. An unavailable dungeon transition creates a capability/access blocker or an investigation support goal. It must not produce an endless walk-to-coordinate loop.

## 5. Required data model

Add a declarative guide catalogue, separate from observed world knowledge. Suggested new modules are `src/agency/build-guides.ts` and `src/training/guide-leads.ts`; these names describe proposed files, not files already added.

Each build entry needs:

- Stable ID, human-readable name, source IDs, research date and source-game scope.
- A concise rationale, strengths to investigate, limitations, and prerequisite content.
- Exact protected XP, chosen Attack/Defence/Prayer caps, and optional milestones for other skills.
- Required item/spell/prayer/access capabilities, with unknown/supported/unsupported states.
- Reusable training-lead IDs, resource needs, review conditions and permitted transitions.

Each training lead needs:

- Source and provenance, NPC family and textual location description.
- Expected purpose: offensive XP, supplies, money, access knowledge or method comparison.
- Required route/transition/safespot capabilities and known hazards.
- Compatibility status separate from personal reachability and method-effectiveness confidence.
- A local-content binding added only through the existing validated catalogue pipeline.

Keep the original claim alongside agent-specific evidence. Do not overwrite 'a guide suggests this' with 'personally verified' after a single unrelated action.

## 6. Selection, planning and learning

Choose from compatible profiles using the agent's interests, current irreversible XP, available equipment, supply capacity and long-term objective. Role hints may influence scores, but should not preselect an identical build for every character.

When the combat formula has been verified for this server, evaluate the marginal combat-level cost of proposed Attack, Prayer, Hitpoints and offensive-skill changes. Without that verification, record the estimate as unknown; do not label the character combat-level-optimal.

Start with low-commitment trials where possible. Choose equipment, supply and method experiments within the current caps before deciding that the build itself is ineffective. A capped character cannot undo XP to conduct a reverse comparison.

For training comparison, evaluate complete preparation -> travel -> training -> return cycles. Record permitted XP, resource consumption, trip duration, actual losses, verified loot, downtime and uncertainty. No fixed internet XP/hour or price is a success criterion.

A proposed initial experiment may compare several short, resource-bounded sessions rather than one long grind. The session count and budgets are tunable engineering settings, not research-established optimal values. Update preferences from repeated attributable outcomes under comparable equipment, skills and access conditions.

Reconsider methods after new gear, supplies, route knowledge, spell access or credible new leads. A new strategy cannot override an unresolved purchase, transfer or other possibly completed mutation.

Do not automatically abandon a pure after a fixed count of costly encounters. First compare safer methods, supplies, equipment and tactics. A later irreversible cap change needs a specific expected benefit, considered alternatives and evidence saved in the strategy history. Exiting a pure strategy is not itself proof that Defence will solve the problem.

## 7. Integration requirements

1. Replace the two-branch choice in `development.ts` with guide-catalogue selection. Preserve valid existing state and pending actions; migrate with an explicit version and recorded rationale.
2. Preserve the selected strategy through `LiveAgency` and the Director. Milestones and access investigations become parent-linked goals, not action-shaped top-level objectives.
3. Feed training leads into the existing `TrainingDiscovery`/catalogue path. Keep server-resolved NPC identities, transitions, collision checks and current dispatch validation authoritative.
4. Enforce build boundaries across attacks, mixed styles, long-range/defensive options, bone use, spellcasting and supported quest reward actions. Unsupported reward semantics block that action, not all unrelated progress.
5. Add compact current-state reporting: selected guide/profile, source, chosen caps, support goal, trial method, confidence and why alternatives were rejected. Do not dump legacy memory as current policy.
6. Gate members content, special attacks, safespotting and spell execution independently. Configuring a profile must not claim to implement its missing executor.
7. Keep individual learning and deliberate knowledge-sharing semantics. A report from another agent is a sourced lead, not collective omniscience.

## 8. Acceptance tests

- The same role can choose different compatible strategies for different observed states, with reasons.
- A 2+ Defence character cannot adopt the '1 Defence' label or lose its history.
- A 40-Attack melee pure may prepare Attack up to its chosen cap; Attack is not accidentally frozen at 1.
- Prayer training and all observed mixed-skill actions respect the selected exact-XP boundaries.
- A guide recommending a post-revision item/prayer/site cannot create an executable unsupported action.
- A rock-crab lead remains conditional when the server's date/capabilities are unknown.
- A guide's safespot claim does not authorize combat until local access and positioning are validated.
- Travel or opening a bank cannot complete a combat/build objective.
- The better measured full-trip method can outrank the guide's initial preference.
- New relevant evidence can restore a method's eligibility, without replaying unknown transactions.
- Three bad encounters alone cannot automatically remove protected XP boundaries.
- Restart preserves the profile, sources, caps, trial results and pending receipts.
- No PvP or paid-model calls are enabled by loading this catalogue.

## 9. Sources and retrieval limits

The OSRS Wiki pages below were available through indexed search extracts; direct page retrieval was blocked for several Wiki URLs. Only supported portions were used. The Lost City roadmap was fetched directly. This is a curated research specification, not a claim that every linked guide was exhaustively reviewed or that its current entirety applies to the private server.
